title: Ridgepost Capital to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Host Investor Call
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Ridgepost Capital's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
DALLAS, July 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Ridgepost Capital, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=zffP3TXggVVJg0kXX2apy17REJX8COnpDO4amco6TzKfLlDXe73DCpdektbsjMZysVPudkXfT2OcRwjKI9RugMh_TOKeakFwfhoVrGslNjI=) (NYSE: RPC) (“Ridgepost Capital” or the “Company”), a leading private markets solutions provider, today announced it will release financial results for the second quarter 2026 before the market open on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, and host a conference call at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time.


The webcast may be accessed[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Kh2yarKCaLOkG_876xsYfyrR-5MVCPLbTc3X3-RGDXUbZW_cxW6N90N3qbtAcLA2pkqKa8R6D4aLpULjZ0pkWdyB83clWrYxP2Yt_gf8iSA=) . All participants joining by telephone should register[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Kh2yarKCaLOkG_876xsYf1skCrrKwIdacmfE2upJiN_6pq3MWpTmXif7_l3GSrdEYgSEdyBAHzxhadoEcE-JQCUAnW2NhqcCQIz6XBOepRRzzSeNs6LWQFDPB5KANKk31JwgcLNbIzM3QlFjszGMMxpJavWN-guP31DaS52jIBA=) for personal dial-in and PIN numbers.


For those unable to participate in the live call, a replay will be made available on the Company’s Investor Relations page.


**About Ridgepost Capital**
Ridgepost Capital (NYSE: RPC) is a leading private markets solutions provider with over $45 billion in assets under management as of March 31, 2026. Ridgepost Capital invests across Private Equity, Private Credit, and Venture Capital in access-constrained strategies, with a focus on the middle and lower-middle market. Ridgepost Capital’s products have a global investor base and aim to deliver compelling risk-adjusted returns. For additional information, please visit[www.ridgepostcapital.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=6KZ_MO1W-Zn9s8hgWgyU7Lc2mG49uDt3o-k0GfwGc44Sbk0QtNMOqtVdsJI3axJj0E_1nIfatcXR5I_PksBCemEMQ8ssRCEoRIFdrBoOBWc=) .
